executable_frozen_fit_recommendation.boundary: Include already frozen observed-image near-boundary teacher labels. Report boundary and strong/footprint fallback separately. No new ratio/coverage/quality filter.
executable_frozen_fit_recommendation.fit: One predeclared2000 updates,AdamW lr3e-4/WD.001/clip5,initializationseed20261023. No restart after first update.
executable_frozen_fit_recommendation.selection: Every100,strict-lowest equal mean of four source x class VAL BCE,earliest ties,update0 excluded. Fixed .5; no current or public-real performance-based threshold tuning.
executable_frozen_fit_recommendation.calibration: Balanced sampling and four-strata selection weight rare covered classes above raw population frequency. A sigmoid score is not certified deployment-calibrated probability. Report both overall and per-source/class counts.

Public emulated q must preserve instance grouping and whole8 correlation; errorbank uses synthetic TRAIN only, not YCB VAL/current errors. GT shape/pose-conditioned emulation is not an actual initializer benchmark.
SourceVAL is conditional/reused:84 synthetic VAL frames were used for V75 checkpoint selection. Do not call this a new untouched fullsystemtest.
YCB multiple instances share RGB frames; maintain whole-scene source splits and do not use per-instance random split.
GT U is not a negative or a trained confidence class. Factual input-invalid U and unknown teacher U must be reported separately.
Saved NLL_FP32 on U uses labels.clamp(0,1) only as a placeholder; never aggregate it outside primaryknown masks.
GT reference-in-crop does not mean full teacher disk is seen in local crop. Report continuous rho disk full-containment versus partial coverage after binding; do not change frozen admission.
